############################################################
# AURORA OS analysis:
# Continuous-variable Cox model for median TFx
#
# Input:
#   AURORA_all_patients_median_TFx_OS_clean.csv
#
# Expected columns:
#   patient_id
#   Subtype
#   median_TFx
#   Overall_Survival_days
#   Event
#
# Event:
#   1 = death
#   0 = censored
############################################################

```{r}
############################################################
# 0. Setup
############################################################

rm(list = ls())

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

required_pkgs <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "readr",
  "stringr",
  "survival",
  "ggplot2",
  "tibble",
  "splines"
)

missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!required_pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())]

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ",
    paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "),
    "\nInstall using:\n",
    "install.packages(c(",
    paste(sprintf('\"%s\"', missing_pkgs), collapse = ", "),
    "))"
  )
}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(splines)


############################################################
# 1. User settings
############################################################

survival_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/Survival"

input_file <- file.path(
  survival_dir,
  "AURORA_all_patients_median_TFx_OS_clean.csv"
)

out_dir <- file.path(
  survival_dir,
  "OS_continuous_median_TFx_Cox_model"
)

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Match your current OS analysis
TFX_MIN_FILTER <- 3

# Small constant only needed if you later include values near zero.
# Here TFx >= 3, so log2(median_TFx) is safe.
set.seed(123)


############################################################
# 2. Helper functions
############################################################

clean_event <- function(x) {
  
  if (is.numeric(x) || is.integer(x)) {
    return(as.integer(x))
  }
  
  x0 <- tolower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  
  out <- case_when(
    x0 %in% c("1", "event", "death", "dead", "yes", "true") ~ 1L,
    x0 %in% c("0", "censored", "censor", "alive", "no", "false") ~ 0L,
    TRUE ~ NA_integer_
  )
  
  return(out)
}


clean_subtype <- function(x) {
  
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "Her2", "HER2")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "HER-2", "HER2")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "HR\\+\\s*HER2\\-", "HR+ HER2-")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "HR\\+\\s*HER2\\+", "HR+ HER2+")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "HR\\-\\s*HER2\\-", "HR- HER2-")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "HR\\-\\s*HER2\\+", "HR- HER2+")
  x <- str_squish(x)
  
  return(x)
}


format_p <- function(p) {
  
  if (is.na(p)) return(NA_character_)
  
  if (p < 0.001) {
    return(formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))
  } else {
    return(formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4))
  }
}


tidy_cox <- function(model, model_name) {
  
  s <- summary(model)
  
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
  ci_df <- as.data.frame(s$conf.int)
  
  out <- tibble(
    model = model_name,
    term = rownames(coef_df),
    beta = coef_df[, "coef"],
    HR = ci_df[, "exp(coef)"],
    lower_95CI = ci_df[, "lower .95"],
    upper_95CI = ci_df[, "upper .95"],
    p_value = coef_df[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    p_value_formatted = sapply(coef_df[, "Pr(>|z|)"], format_p)
  )
  
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  
  return(out)
}


save_ph_test <- function(model, model_name, out_dir) {
  
  ph <- cox.zph(model)
  
  ph_df <- as.data.frame(ph$table)
  ph_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(ph_df, var = "term")
  ph_df$model <- model_name
  
  write_csv(
    ph_df,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(model_name, "_cox_zph_PH_test.csv"))
  )
  
  pdf(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(model_name, "_cox_zph_PH_plot.pdf")),
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
  print(plot(ph))
  dev.off()
  
  return(ph_df)
}


############################################################
# 3. Load OS file
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Loading OS file\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop("Input file not found:\n", input_file)
}

os_raw <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Input file:\n")
cat(input_file, "\n\n")

cat("Raw dimensions:\n")
print(dim(os_raw))

cat("\nColumns:\n")
print(names(os_raw))


############################################################
# 4. Check required columns
############################################################

required_cols <- c(
  "patient_id",
  "median_TFx",
  "Overall_Survival_days",
  "Event"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(os_raw))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
    "\nAvailable columns:\n",
    paste(names(os_raw), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (!"Subtype" %in% names(os_raw)) {
  os_raw$Subtype <- NA_character_
}


############################################################
# 5. Prepare analysis dataset
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Preparing continuous-variable OS dataset\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

os_df <- os_raw %>%
  transmute(
    patient_id = as.character(patient_id),
    Subtype = clean_subtype(Subtype),
    median_TFx = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(median_TFx)),
    Overall_Survival_days = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Overall_Survival_days)),
    OS_months = Overall_Survival_days / 30.4375,
    Event = clean_event(Event)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = str_trim(patient_id)
  )

cat("\nBefore filtering:\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(os_df), "\n")
cat("Unique patients:", n_distinct(os_df$patient_id), "\n")
cat("Non-missing median_TFx:", sum(!is.na(os_df$median_TFx)), "\n")
cat("Non-missing OS days:", sum(!is.na(os_df$Overall_Survival_days)), "\n")
cat("Non-missing Event:", sum(!is.na(os_df$Event)), "\n")

# Remove duplicated patients if present
dup_patients <- os_df %>%
  count(patient_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(dup_patients) > 0) {
  
  cat("\nWARNING: duplicated patient IDs found. Keeping first row per patient.\n")
  print(head(dup_patients, 20))
  
  write_csv(
    dup_patients,
    file.path(out_dir, "00_duplicated_patient_ids.csv")
  )
  
  os_df <- os_df %>%
    arrange(patient_id) %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Main filter
os_df <- os_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(patient_id),
    patient_id != "",
    !is.na(median_TFx),
    !is.na(OS_months),
    !is.na(Event),
    Event %in% c(0, 1),
    OS_months >= 0,
    median_TFx >= TFX_MIN_FILTER
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TFx_per_1percent = median_TFx,
    TFx_per_5percent = median_TFx / 5,
    TFx_per_10percent = median_TFx / 10,
    log2_TFx = log2(median_TFx)
  )

cat("\nAfter filtering:\n")
cat("Patients:", nrow(os_df), "\n")
cat("Unique patients:", n_distinct(os_df$patient_id), "\n")
cat("Deaths:", sum(os_df$Event == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Censored:", sum(os_df$Event == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Median TFx:", median(os_df$median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("TFx range:", min(os_df$median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(os_df$median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Median OS months:", median(os_df$OS_months, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\nSubtype counts:\n")
print(table(os_df$Subtype, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nSubtype deaths/events:\n")
print(table(os_df$Subtype, os_df$Event, useNA = "ifany"))

write_csv(
  os_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "01_OS_continuous_analysis_dataset.csv")
)


############################################################
# 6. QC summary
############################################################

qc_summary <- tibble(
  input_file = input_file,
  tfx_filter = paste0("median_TFx >= ", TFX_MIN_FILTER, "%"),
  n_patients = nrow(os_df),
  n_unique_patients = n_distinct(os_df$patient_id),
  n_deaths = sum(os_df$Event == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_censored = sum(os_df$Event == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_TFx = median(os_df$median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE),
  min_TFx = min(os_df$median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_TFx = max(os_df$median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_OS_months_observed = median(os_df$OS_months, na.rm = TRUE)
)

write_csv(
  qc_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "02_OS_continuous_QC_summary.csv")
)

print(qc_summary)


############################################################
# 7. Primary continuous Cox models
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Running primary continuous Cox models\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

# Model A: HR per 1% increase in median TFx
cox_per1 <- coxph(
  Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ TFx_per_1percent,
  data = os_df
)

# Model B: HR per 5% increase in median TFx
# This is usually easier to report.
cox_per5 <- coxph(
  Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ TFx_per_5percent,
  data = os_df
)

# Model C: HR per 10% increase in median TFx
cox_per10 <- coxph(
  Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ TFx_per_10percent,
  data = os_df
)

# Model D: HR per doubling of median TFx
# Because log2(TFx) increases by 1 when TFx doubles.
cox_log2 <- coxph(
  Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ log2_TFx,
  data = os_df
)

continuous_results <- bind_rows(
  tidy_cox(cox_per1, "Univariable Cox: per 1% increase in median TFx"),
  tidy_cox(cox_per5, "Univariable Cox: per 5% increase in median TFx"),
  tidy_cox(cox_per10, "Univariable Cox: per 10% increase in median TFx"),
  tidy_cox(cox_log2, "Univariable Cox: per doubling of median TFx")
)

write_csv(
  continuous_results,
  file.path(out_dir, "03_OS_continuous_Cox_univariable_results.csv")
)

cat("\nContinuous Cox results:\n")
print(continuous_results)


############################################################
# 8. Subtype-adjusted Cox models
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Running subtype-adjusted Cox models\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

# Only run adjusted models if Subtype exists and has >1 level
subtype_available <- !all(is.na(os_df$Subtype)) &&
  length(unique(na.omit(os_df$Subtype))) > 1

if (subtype_available) {
  
  os_df <- os_df %>%
    mutate(
      Subtype = factor(Subtype)
    )
  
  # Set HR+ HER2- as reference if present
  if ("HR+ HER2-" %in% levels(os_df$Subtype)) {
    os_df$Subtype <- relevel(os_df$Subtype, ref = "HR+ HER2-")
  }
  
  cox_adj_per5 <- coxph(
    Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ TFx_per_5percent + Subtype,
    data = os_df
  )
  
  cox_adj_log2 <- coxph(
    Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ log2_TFx + Subtype,
    data = os_df
  )
  
  adjusted_results <- bind_rows(
    tidy_cox(cox_adj_per5, "Subtype-adjusted Cox: per 5% increase in median TFx"),
    tidy_cox(cox_adj_log2, "Subtype-adjusted Cox: per doubling of median TFx")
  )
  
  write_csv(
    adjusted_results,
    file.path(out_dir, "04_OS_continuous_Cox_subtype_adjusted_results.csv")
  )
  
  cat("\nSubtype-adjusted Cox results:\n")
  print(adjusted_results)
  
} else {
  
  cat("\nSubtype not available or has only one level. Skipping subtype-adjusted models.\n")
  
  adjusted_results <- tibble(
    note = "Subtype-adjusted models not run because Subtype is missing or has only one level."
  )
  
  write_csv(
    adjusted_results,
    file.path(out_dir, "04_OS_continuous_Cox_subtype_adjusted_results.csv")
  )
}


############################################################
# 9. Test proportional hazards assumption
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Testing proportional hazards assumption\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

ph_per5 <- save_ph_test(
  cox_per5,
  "cox_per5_univariable",
  out_dir
)

ph_log2 <- save_ph_test(
  cox_log2,
  "cox_log2_univariable",
  out_dir
)

if (exists("cox_adj_per5")) {
  ph_adj_per5 <- save_ph_test(
    cox_adj_per5,
    "cox_per5_subtype_adjusted",
    out_dir
  )
}

ph_all <- bind_rows(
  ph_per5,
  ph_log2,
  if (exists("ph_adj_per5")) ph_adj_per5 else NULL
)

write_csv(
  ph_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "05_OS_continuous_Cox_PH_assumption_summary.csv")
)

print(ph_all)


############################################################
# 10. Nonlinearity check using spline Cox model
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Running spline Cox model for nonlinearity check\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

# This checks whether the TFx-OS relationship is approximately linear
# or whether there is a threshold-like relationship.
cox_spline <- coxph(
  Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ ns(median_TFx, df = 3),
  data = os_df
)

spline_anova <- anova(cox_spline)

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(spline_anova) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term"),
  file.path(out_dir, "06_OS_spline_Cox_model_anova.csv")
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(summary(cox_spline)),
  file.path(out_dir, "06_OS_spline_Cox_model_summary.txt")
)

cat("\nSpline Cox model summary:\n")
print(summary(cox_spline))


############################################################
# 11. Spline plot: predicted relative hazard across TFx
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Creating spline relative hazard plot\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

# Use 1st to 99th percentile for stable plotting
tfx_grid <- seq(
  quantile(os_df$median_TFx, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
  quantile(os_df$median_TFx, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

newdat <- data.frame(
  median_TFx = tfx_grid
)

pred <- predict(
  cox_spline,
  newdata = newdat,
  type = "lp",
  se.fit = TRUE
)

# Center relative hazard at the cohort median TFx
ref_dat <- data.frame(
  median_TFx = median(os_df$median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE)
)

ref_lp <- predict(
  cox_spline,
  newdata = ref_dat,
  type = "lp"
)

spline_plot_df <- tibble(
  median_TFx = tfx_grid,
  log_relative_hazard = as.numeric(pred$fit - ref_lp),
  se = as.numeric(pred$se.fit),
  relative_hazard = exp(log_relative_hazard),
  lower_95CI = exp(log_relative_hazard - 1.96 * se),
  upper_95CI = exp(log_relative_hazard + 1.96 * se)
)

write_csv(
  spline_plot_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "07_OS_spline_predicted_relative_hazard.csv")
)

spline_plot <- ggplot(
  spline_plot_df,
  aes(x = median_TFx, y = relative_hazard)
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower_95CI, ymax = upper_95CI),
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Continuous association between median TFx and overall survival",
    subtitle = "Spline Cox model; relative hazard centered at cohort median TFx",
    x = "Patient-level median TFx (%)",
    y = "Relative hazard of death"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "07_OS_spline_relative_hazard_plot.pdf"),
  plot = spline_plot,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 5.5
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "07_OS_spline_relative_hazard_plot.png"),
  plot = spline_plot,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)


############################################################
# 12. Forest-style plot for continuous Cox models
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Creating continuous Cox forest plot\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

forest_df <- continuous_results %>%
  filter(term %in% c(
    "TFx_per_1percent",
    "TFx_per_5percent",
    "TFx_per_10percent",
    "log2_TFx"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      term == "TFx_per_1percent" ~ "Per 1% increase in median TFx",
      term == "TFx_per_5percent" ~ "Per 5% increase in median TFx",
      term == "TFx_per_10percent" ~ "Per 10% increase in median TFx",
      term == "log2_TFx" ~ "Per doubling of median TFx",
      TRUE ~ term
    ),
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(label))
  )

forest_plot <- ggplot(
  forest_df,
  aes(x = HR, y = label)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower_95CI, xmax = upper_95CI),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Continuous median TFx association with overall survival",
    x = "Hazard ratio for death, log scale",
    y = ""
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "08_OS_continuous_Cox_forest_plot.pdf"),
  plot = forest_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4.5
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "08_OS_continuous_Cox_forest_plot.png"),
  plot = forest_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 300
)


############################################################
# 13. Final reporting table
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Creating final reporting table\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

# Pull the most useful reporting rows
primary_per5 <- continuous_results %>%
  filter(model == "Univariable Cox: per 5% increase in median TFx")

primary_log2 <- continuous_results %>%
  filter(model == "Univariable Cox: per doubling of median TFx")

if (subtype_available) {
  adjusted_per5 <- adjusted_results %>%
    filter(
      model == "Subtype-adjusted Cox: per 5% increase in median TFx",
      term == "TFx_per_5percent"
    )
} else {
  adjusted_per5 <- tibble()
}

final_reporting <- tibble(
  analysis_name = "Continuous-variable Cox model for median TFx and OS",
  input_file = input_file,
  n_patients = nrow(os_df),
  n_deaths = sum(os_df$Event == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_censored = sum(os_df$Event == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  tfx_filter = paste0("median_TFx >= ", TFX_MIN_FILTER, "%"),
  primary_model = "Cox proportional hazards model using median_TFx as continuous variable",
  primary_interpretation_unit = "Per 5% increase in median TFx",
  univariable_per5_HR = primary_per5$HR,
  univariable_per5_lower_95CI = primary_per5$lower_95CI,
  univariable_per5_upper_95CI = primary_per5$upper_95CI,
  univariable_per5_p_value = primary_per5$p_value,
  univariable_log2_HR_per_doubling = primary_log2$HR,
  univariable_log2_lower_95CI = primary_log2$lower_95CI,
  univariable_log2_upper_95CI = primary_log2$upper_95CI,
  univariable_log2_p_value = primary_log2$p_value,
  subtype_adjusted_per5_HR = if (nrow(adjusted_per5) > 0) adjusted_per5$HR else NA_real_,
  subtype_adjusted_per5_lower_95CI = if (nrow(adjusted_per5) > 0) adjusted_per5$lower_95CI else NA_real_,
  subtype_adjusted_per5_upper_95CI = if (nrow(adjusted_per5) > 0) adjusted_per5$upper_95CI else NA_real_,
  subtype_adjusted_per5_p_value = if (nrow(adjusted_per5) > 0) adjusted_per5$p_value else NA_real_
)

write_csv(
  final_reporting,
  file.path(out_dir, "09_OS_continuous_Cox_final_reporting_table.csv")
)

print(final_reporting)


############################################################
# 14. Suggested sentence for PPT/manuscript
############################################################

sentence <- paste0(
  "In a continuous-variable Cox model, each 5% increase in patient-level median TFx ",
  "was associated with a hazard ratio for death of ",
  round(primary_per5$HR, 2),
  " (95% CI, ",
  round(primary_per5$lower_95CI, 2),
  "–",
  round(primary_per5$upper_95CI, 2),
  "; p = ",
  format_p(primary_per5$p_value),
  ")."
)

writeLines(
  sentence,
  file.path(out_dir, "10_OS_continuous_Cox_suggested_sentence.txt")
)

cat("\nSuggested sentence:\n")
cat(sentence, "\n")


############################################################
# 15. Save session info
############################################################

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(out_dir, "11_OS_continuous_Cox_sessionInfo.txt")
)


############################################################
# Done
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Continuous-variable OS Cox analysis complete.\n")
cat("Outputs saved to:\n")
cat(out_dir, "\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
```
